name: YouTube channel listing
collects: list of videos, live streams and shorts (titles, lengths)
tool: discover.py (yt-dlp --flat-playlist on the Videos, Live and Shorts tabs)
how: Asks YouTube for the channel's public lists. No media is requested.
rules: One channel at a time, 5 s apart; stops after three refusals.

name: YouTube channel page
collects: channel id, subscribers, the websites the channel declares
how: Reads the schema.org data on the channel's public page.
rules: robots.txt read first; 4 s between pages; stops after three refusals.

name: YouTube embed lookup
collects: the channel of a recording, and whether it is still online
how: YouTube's public oEmbed answer for one recording.
rules: robots.txt read first; 4 s between requests.

name: YouTube audio
tool: download_audio.py, through run_all.py on a home connection
how: yt-dlp fetches a small audio stream, which is re-encoded to mono 24 kbps Opus.
rules: Refused from cloud servers (bot check). Nothing tries to get past that: it runs on the owner's computer.

name: YouTube captions
tool: fetch_captions.py, through run_all.py on a home connection
how: Named English caption tracks only, no machine translations.
rules: Refused from cloud servers, like the audio.

name: Apple Podcasts search
collects: the RSS address of a show
how: Apple's public search API. A show counts only when its own website or the person's site vouches for it.
rules: About 20 calls a minute at most; namesakes are set aside.

name: Podcast feed (RSS)
how: Reads the feed every podcast app reads.
rules: One feed per host at a time; stops a host after three refusals.

name: Podcast episode audio
how: Downloads the file the feed hands to podcast apps and re-encodes it to 24 kbps Opus.
rules: Two downloads per host at most, one start a second; stops a host after refusals; a free-disk floor.

name: Transcript the feed links
how: The publisher's own transcript (<podcast:transcript>: VTT, SRT or HTML).
rules: A robots.txt that says no is obeyed; a site that cannot be reached is left alone for the run.

name: Official site survey
collects: what the site publishes (feeds, sitemap, podcast links)
how: Reads robots.txt, the home page and the sitemap. Saves addresses and counts only.
rules: robots.txt obeyed; one request a second per site.

name: Pages from the maker's sitemap
how: The address family that holds the maker's messages is chosen from the sitemap; each page's text is extracted.
rules: robots.txt obeyed for every page; one request a second per site.

name: Audio on the maker's own site
how: Recordings the maker offers for free download on their own site.

name: archive.org items
how: archive.org's public metadata service lists each item's files; audio files are downloaded.
rules: robots.txt read first; one request a second; video files of several gigabytes are not fetched from here.

name: Interview type
collects: the kind of each interview episode
how: A reader given the whole transcript (a small model, checked on a sample), or show notes that say the session is channeled live. A title never decides.
rules: Only interviews with live channeling are downloaded.

name: Speech-to-text made here
how: faster-whisper base.en (base for German), on audio already downloaded.
rules: Kept apart from texts that come from the source.

name: Earlier research
how: Work done before this pipeline: the Bashar Index digests (from auto-transcripts, 2026-10) and ArchiveShelf's inventory.
rules: Their counts are shown as they were recorded.
